cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Response: After Frodo Baggins exhausts to defend an attack, exhaust The One Ring and spend 1 [fellowship] resource to target the attacking enemy. Then, this attack deals no damage and each player raises his threat by 2.
cards.flavor: "But there is more about you now than appears on the surface." <cite>Bilbo, The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Lust for the Ring
cards.text: Peril. Surge. When Revealed: Attach to a non-[fellowship] hero in play. Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Forced: After The One Ring exhausts, raise each player's threat by 1 and reduce attached hero's [willpower] to 0 until the end of the round."

cards.name: The Hunt is Up!
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy and adds it to the staging area. One of those enemies must be Great Warg Chief, if able. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: During the travel phase, the players must travel to a location, if able. Forced: After a location enters play, place 1 damage on it.  Forced: After an enemy engages a player, place 1 damage on the active location, if able.

cards.name: The Council of Elrond
cards.text: Setup: Set Lust for the Ring, Redhorn Pass, Doors of Durin and Watcher in the Water aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Forced: At the end of the planning phase, each player places the top card of his deck faceup in front of him, in player order, until there are a total of 4 faceup cards between the players. The first player chooses 1 faceup card to player for 0 cost, 1 to add to its owners hand, 1 to discard, and 1 to shuffle into its owner's deck. Then, either shuffle Lust for the Ring into the encounter deck, or raise each player's threat by 5. Advance to stage 2.

cards.name: Hound of Sauron
cards.text:
Surge.
Hound of Sauron gets -5 engagement cost for each enemy in the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if it was engaged this round).

cards.name: Great Warg Chief
cards.text:
Cannot have attachments.
Forced: After Great Warg Chief engages you, discard cards from the encounter deck until a Warg enemy is discarded. Put that enemy into play engaged with you.

cards.name: The Gates of Moria
cards.text: When Revealed: Make Doors of Durin the active location. Add Watcher in the Water to the staging area. Discard all tokens from the Ring-bearer and place it (and each card attached to it) facedown under Watcher in the Water.
cards.back_text: There can be 2 active locations. During the travel phase, the players must travel to a location, if able. Forced: After an enemy engages a player, place 1 damage on each active location.  If Doors of Durin is explored, the players win the game.

cards.name: Storm of Howls
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Either the Warg enemy in the staging area with the highest engagement cost attacks you, or each Warg enemy gets -20 engagement cost until the end of the round. If no Warg enemy is in the staging area, Storm of Howls gains surge.

cards.name: Doors of Durin
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
Progress must be placed on each other active location before it can be placed here. Progress cannot be placed here unless the first player controls the Ring-bearer.  If there are 9 damage tokens here, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Hills of Hollin
cards.text: While Hills of Hollin is the active location, each enemy in the staging area gets +5 engagement cost.  Forced: When Hills of Hollin is explored, each player raises his threat by 1 for each damage here.

cards.name: Bitter Cold
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose: either discard each ally he controls, or raise his threat by 1 for each ally he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Crebain from Dunland
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Either exhaust a hero you control, or engage Crebain from Dunland. Forced: After Crebain from Dunland engages a player, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Regiments of Crows
cards.text: When Revealed: Place 3 damage on each active location.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Undefended damage from this attack must be assigned to the active location.

cards.name: Redhorn Foothills
cards.text: While Redhorn Foothills is the active location, it gains: "Forced: After an enemy is added to the staging area, it gets -5 engagement cost until the end of the round."  Forced: When Redhorn Foothills is explored, each player must discard X cards from his hand at random. X is the number of damage here.

cards.name: Watcher in the Water
cards.text:
Idestructible. Immune to player card effects.
Cannot leave the staging area but is considered to be engaged with each player. Forced: After placing the 6th damage here, the first player takes control of the Ring-bearer, exhausted with 1 damage on it.

cards.name: The Nine Walkers
cards.text: When Revealed: Make Redhorn Pass the active location. The first player reveals cards from the encounter deck until there is at least X [threat] in the staging area. X is twice the number of players in the game.
cards.back_text: During the travel phase, the players must travel to a location, if able.  Forced: After an enemy engages a player, place 1 damage on the active location, if able.

cards.name: Eregion
cards.text: Forced: When Eregion is explored, the players as a group must discard X allies from play. X is the number of damage here.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards a non-objective attachment he controls.

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.text: Setup: The first player claims The One Ring and attaches it to the Ring-bearer.  Attached hero does not count against the hero limit. The first player gains control of attached hero.   If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Tree-crowned Hill
cards.text:
While Tree-crowned Hill is the active location, each enemy gets -1 [threat].
Forced: When Tree-crowned Hill is explored, the players, as a group, exhaust X characters in play. X is the number of damage here.

cards.name: Snowdrifts
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to the active location. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text, "Limit 1 per location. No more than 3 progress can be placed on attached location each round.") If Snowdrifts is not attached to the active location, it gains surge.

cards.name: Howling Warg
cards.text: Forced: When Howling Warg attacks, place 1 damage on an active location.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destoys a character, place 1 damage on an active location.

cards.name: Redhorn Pass
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
Forced: When Redhorn Pass is explored, each player assigns X damage among characters he controls. X is the number of damage here.
